clause: Format family — PDF/X prepress export (row 26, SOX) [STU-IO-006]

scope.summary: Implement StudioExportRecipe for prepress PDF/X (.pdf, row 26), direction X only: standards-constrained prepress PDF with color conversion, marks, and bleed preserved to the chosen PDF/X standard (reuses ColorEngine soft-proof/intents from 14.8). Five-artifact gate + export fixtures + receipts + recovery.
acceptance_criteria: PDF/X X-only prepress with color/marks/bleed to standard; fixtures+receipts+recovery; manual entry
proof_targets: PDF/X export fixtures + standard-constraint receipt + recovery test
expected_tests: fixtures: PDF/X export fixtures per standard
test: color conversion + marks + bleed constrained to chosen PDF/X standard
receipt: out-of-standard-feature receipt; recovery: unexportable content fails closed

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

risk_if_missed: No prepress PDF/X; print-production exchange gap.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
